notes:
Summary: Lodestar Logic is a mid-size devtools company building an internal developer search and RAG layer for code and engineering docs. Primary pain points: large embedding corpus (~20M+ vectors), need low tail latency for search/rerank (p95 < 200ms), frequent re-indexing (daily incremental + weekly full rebuild), and strict security (SSO/SAML, audit logs, data residency in US). They prefer model-agnostic routing: embeddings computed offline, reranker (cross-encoder) hosted on dedicated GPU pool with automatic fallback to quantized variant under load. Cost sensitivity: want per-query cost estimate for 99th percentile traffic spikes and desire batching/buffer strategies to reduce unit cost without breaking latency SLOs.

Notes from calls (shorthand):
- "We must keep code embeddings in our VPC; no plaintext storage in managed buckets." — Eng lead.
- Interested in Redwood's autoscaling + canary rollouts for reranker models.
- Willing to use Dedicated or Private; leaning Private for audit controls but wants Redwood to host POC.
- Reindex cadence: daily incremental (~200k new/changed files) + weekly full rebuild of ~20M vectors. Concern: time-to-ready for full rebuild and how prefix/KV caching interacts with reindex.
- Latency targets: p50 < 100ms, p95 < 200ms for top-K retrieval + re-rank end-to-end. Throughput: sustained 200 qps for internal CI-driven traffic peaks; burst to 1k qps during release windows.
- Preferred models: open-embedding models (custom fine-tuned) + reranker cross-encoders (model name TBD). Ask: whether Redwood Optimize can recommend quantization + batching config for their traffic profile.

POC ask: 1) Provision dedicated cluster in us-east-1 with VPC peering and SSO enabled, 2) run a full-corpus reindex to validate throughput/time and verify incremental delta process, 3) measure median/p95 latency for retrieval+rerank at 200 qps and at burst, 4) provide cost-per-query estimate and recommendations to reduce unit cost (batching threshold, caching TTLs, quantized reranker path).

Stated next: send SSO metadata, approve temporary dedicated capacity (2x A10G equiv), security signoff on data residency and KMS integration. Shortnotes: budgets under review; procurement expects final decision by 2025-02.
